messages:
maria: opened PR #4827 to refresh the hello-deck quickstart auth + first-deploy instructions. Main goals: simplify auth example, fix cross-links, add a tiny Docker snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827

sam: nice — quick question: did you keep the PKCE flow anywhere or fully replace with ephemeral token flow?

maria: replaced PKCE in the quickstart to reduce noise for first-run. kept a migration appendix for apps that need PKCE. ephemeral example uses short-lived tokens and a tiny server-side exchange.

jenny: CI shows linkcheck failing on the samples/old-auth link — looks like that folder got removed.

ci-bot: build failed — jobs/docs/linkcheck — 1 broken link: /samples/old-auth -> 404

maria: thanks — that was intentional, forgot to update the cross-link from the troubleshooting doc. fixing now.

nate: small API naming note: the new docker snippet sets REDWOOD_API_KEY, but our SDK examples use REDWOOD_KEY in a few places. can we pick one to avoid confusion?

sam: +1 to consistency. prefer REDWOOD_KEY?

maria: switched the snippet to REDWOOD_KEY, updated the envvars table and the example code. also added a short note about scopes and expiry window for ephemeral tokens.

jenny: nit: deploy section should mention the build arg to ensure prod behavior in the sample Dockerfile (e.g., `--build-arg NODE_ENV=production`).

maria: added that line and a one-liner explanation. pushed a new commit to the PR. requesting reviews from @sam and @jenny.

sam: reviewing now — left one inline about the wording "production-ready" -> suggest "recommended for demo / production testing" to avoid overpromising.

maria: updated wording per your suggestion.

ci-bot: build passed — linkcheck OK; docs/lint reported minor warnings: sentence length at docs/quickstart.md:72.

jenny: any other blockers before we merge?

sam: none from me besides the wording fix which is done. Approving. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks! planning to merge after CI is green and backport a short note to v2-guides branch.

nate: could you also add a 3-bullet migration note for teams moving from PKCE to ephemeral tokens (server exchange, token refresh cadence, scope mapping)? would help support calls.

maria: added a small migration checklist at the end of the auth section. merging now :shipit:

ci-bot: merged PR #4827 by maria (commit abc123) into main.

maria: follow-up: I'll open a tiny doc-only PR to update the samples repo path and add a link from the migration note to the samples repo. thanks everyone!
